description.value:
You've made your living by giving dangerous people access to dangerous things. Hauling loads of expensive arms into the kinds of places that need them often necessitates having to grab what you can and run when a third party gets involved. You've become skilled at the unsubtle art of being the biggest threat in the room, often just by showing that you aren't afraid to use your own wares in a pinch.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Intimidation skill and the Warfare Lore skill. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Intimidating Shot] skill feat.
